Check out this update on the *Bhandara Bypass Project* in Maharashtra! This massive project will transform the busy *NH53* highway into a smooth, 6-lane expressway, easing traffic congestion & making your journeys a breeze.
Here's the lowdown:
• Project Length:* ~14.8 km (combining brownfield and greenfield sections)
Goal: Reduce traffic congestion in Bhandara City on NH53
• Highlights:* Major bridge construction over the Wainganga River
Road laying, divider installation, & safety barriers for a secure ride
Service lanes for easy access to nearby villages
